sentences.text: Jacqueline Marie `` Jackie '' Evancho -LRB- -LSB- iːˈvæŋkoʊ -RSB- ; born April 9 , 2000 -RRB- is an American classical crossover singer who gained wide recognition at an early age and , since 2009 , has issued an EP and seven albums , including a platinum and gold album and three Billboard 200 top 10 debuts .	classical crossover	crossover music#Classical crossover	EP	Extended play
She has released three solo Public Broadcasting Service -LRB- PBS -RRB- concert specials .	Public Broadcasting Service	Public Broadcasting Service

Between 2008 and 2010 , Evancho entered talent competitions , sang the U.S. national anthem at a Pittsburgh Pirates baseball game , gave concerts with Tim Janis and David Foster , issued her first album , Prelude to a Dream , and attracted interest on YouTube .	Pittsburgh	Pittsburgh	U.S. national anthem	The Star-Spangled Banner	Pittsburgh Pirates	Pittsburgh Pirates	Tim Janis	Tim Janis	David Foster	David Foster	Prelude to a Dream	Prelude to a Dream	YouTube	YouTube
In 2010 , at the age of ten , she gained wide notice with her 2nd-place finish in the fifth season of America 's Got Talent .	fifth season	America's Got Talent (season 5)

With the 2010 holiday release of her O Holy Night EP , Evancho became the best-selling debut artist of 2010 , the youngest top-10 debut artist in U.S. history and the youngest solo artist ever to go platinum in the U.S. .	EP	Extended play	O Holy Night	O Holy Night (Jackie Evancho album)
She performed at the 2010 National Christmas Tree lighting in Washington , D.C. .	National Christmas Tree	National Christmas Tree (United States)

In 2011 , her first full-length album , Dream With Me , produced by Foster , debuted at No. 2 on the Billboard 200 chart , and she became the youngest top-5 debut artist in UK history .	Dream With Me	Dream With Me	produced	record producer
Billboard ranked Evancho the top Classical Albums Artist for 2011 .

Later that year , Evancho released a full-length holiday album , Heavenly Christmas , and became the youngest person ever to give a solo concert at Lincoln Center in New York City as part of her Dream With Me Tour .	Dream With Me	Dream With Me	Heavenly Christmas	Heavenly Christmas	Lincoln Center	Lincoln Center	Dream With Me Tour	Jackie Evancho concert tours#Dream With Me Tour

From late 2012 to 2014 , she toured the U.S. to support her 2012 album , Songs from the Silver Screen , which was Evancho 's third top-ten album debut .	toured	Jackie Evancho concert tours#Songs from the Silver Screen Tour	Songs from the Silver Screen	Songs from the Silver Screen

In 2013 she headlined benefit concerts at Carnegie Hall , the LDS Conference Center and with Cirque du Soleil in Las Vegas for the One Drop Foundation .	Carnegie Hall	Carnegie Hall	LDS Conference Center	LDS Conference Center	Cirque du Soleil	Cirque du Soleil	One Drop Foundation	One Drop Foundation

She also appeared in the 2013 Robert Redford film The Company You Keep and modelled for Guess Kids clothing .	Robert Redford	Robert Redford	The Company You Keep	The Company You Keep (film)	Guess Kids	Guess (clothing)
After releasing her 2014 album , Awakening , Evancho began high school while continuing to tour .	Awakening	Awakening (Jackie Evancho album)	continuing to tour	Jackie Evancho concert tours
Later music releases included several singles and collaborations , and a 2016 holiday album , Someday at Christmas .	Someday at Christmas	Someday at Christmas (Jackie Evancho album)

In 2017 , Evancho performed the U.S. national anthem at the presidential inauguration of Donald Trump ; released a studio album , Two Hearts , her seventh consecutive No. 1 release on the U.S. classical albums chart ; and became the youngest person ever to perform a concert series at Café Carlyle .
